groups.name: Planetary Science and Comet Exploration Studies
groups.name_zh: 深空探测与系外彗星化学研究
groups.narrative: Deep space missions analyze Titan's methane lakes as interstellar comets racing through the solar system expose unexpected chemical profiles.
groups.narrative_zh: 深空探测任务对土卫六（Titan）的甲烷湖进行研究，同时飞掠太阳系的星际彗星展现了意料之外的化学成分。
groups.R_reason: The designation of interstellar objects follows a strict, objective scientific naming convention (e.g., 3I/ name).
groups.S_reason: The Minor Planet Center is the world's official clearinghouse for all minor planet and comet discoveries.
groups.T_reason: Clear time window running from today until December 31, 2027.
groups.U_reason: Highly uncertain; while new observatories like the Vera C. Rubin Observatory are coming online to boost detection, actual detection of rare interstellar visitors remains highly unpredictable.
groups.H_reason: Interstellar comets like 'Oumuamua and Borisov capture massive global science media attention.

BDLT.B_reason: The thrill of finding alien solar system visitors attracts sci-fi and astronomy fans.
BDLT.D_reason: Strong disagreement on whether next-generation sky surveys will successfully detect one within this tight timeframe.
BDLT.L_reason: It is a purely global/cosmic event with no localized Philippine impact.

groups.why_users_bet: Bettors will speculate on the capabilities of next-generation telescopes (like LSST) to find rare cosmic objects before the deadline.
